title.zh: 【西联汇款选择 Noah 为其稳定币支付网络提供基础设施】
title.en: 【西联汇款选择 Noah 为其稳定币支付网络提供基础设施】

current_state.zh: Western Union has chosen stablecoin payments infrastructure firm Noah to provide the on-chain banking network, prefunding, FX conversion, and licensing support for its global stablecoin payment platform built on its USDPT dollar stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank on Solana.
current_state.en: Western Union has chosen stablecoin payments infrastructure firm Noah to provide the on-chain banking network, prefunding, FX conversion, and licensing support for its global stablecoin payment platform built on its USDPT dollar stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank on Solana.
